sourceConclusions.conclusion: The final one binding read is after source/sample/result rereads. Its preserved canonical implementation reads binding/rule/result twice, invokes verifyBinding twice, checks exact equality and ends with host revalidation. No cached financial result replaces those proofs.

A found result must match captured request/case/content and the current rule proof. Only a current bound read takes the no-calculation retry branch. The unavailable binding path proceeds through real evaluation and validated binding; denied/stale/conflict outcomes are propagated. Operation identity, authority binding identity/content, kind and lease are checked after async boundaries.

sourceConclusions.topic: Stored threshold is only a candidate
sourceConclusions.conclusion: An exact stored number is recertified under a current direct-USD monotone domain. Current structural baseline/scenario/metadata/operation/engine/parameter/bounds/unit/period/refs are correlated; current two adjacent IEEE witnesses must straddle the criterion, preserve fixed component digest and component order. The canonical domain restricts the parameter to a direct non-HR USD replacement without indirect defer writes; monotonicity is not inferred from three samples.

Stored threshold evidence must equal current producer refs including deterministic order, not merely be self-hashed. The full reconstructed sensitivity digest must equal stored.resultDigest. Source/baseline and units are reread; coverage qualification and source fences remain current; incoming inputs and authority are checked again after the final capture await. The actual host idempotency adapter performs revalidate; a physical fence alone is not treated as authorization.

Known-subtotal exactness does not resolve missing cost categories or apply a scenario. Coverage certificates retain current C10 classification/evidence guards. Tests retain omitted training as conditioned, all three training states, null totals on hypothetical samples, unknown price/FX and unchanged human choices/receipts.
